## FAQ
Q1. What is Dunner?
A1. A tool that writes 3 professional reminder emails to chase late invoices from a client, amount, and days overdue.
Q2. How many reminders do I get?
A2. It returns 3 ready-to-send emails with built-in escalation.
Q3. Can I pick the tone?
A3. It offers 3 tones so you match the client relationship while staying professional.
Q4. Are they ready to send?
A4. Yes. The copy is copy-ready to send as-is.
Q5. What do I need to enter?
A5. A client, the amount, days overdue, and a tone.
Q6. Who should use Dunner?
A6. Freelancers and small shops who want to collect late payments without the awkwardness.
